📌 SPRINT.REVIEW - Sprint Review

🎯 YOUR ROLE: You are the technical assistant. Present the sprint increment to the user (the Product Owner). The USER decides: accept or needs_work.

Context layers available:
  • STATE (layer above) — sprint progress (completed/total tasks, task statuses)
  • DELTA (layer above) — cross-sprint history for context
  • PROJECT (layer above) — project conventions

Instruction:
  Read the sprint progress from the STATE layer and cross-sprint
  history from the DELTA layer. Present the sprint summary to the user.

  SPRINT REVIEW
  -------------------------------------------
  Sprint goal: <state.sprint_goal>
  Progress:    <state.completed_count>/<state.task_count>

  TASKS (from STATE layer)
  ✅ <TASK-001> - <objective>
     Status: <completed>, PO: accepted
  ⏳ <TASK-002> - <objective>
     Status: <in_progress>
  ❌ <TASK-003> - <objective>
     Status: <pending>

  <task_summary>

Ask the user:

  Options:
    . accept     -> sprint accepted, continue to retrospective (RETRO)
    . needs_work -> sprint needs more work, return to dashboard (ACTIVE)

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"accept","feedback":"<comment about the sprint>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"needs_work","feedback":"<what is missing>"}'

Output:
  accept     -> transition to RETRO for retrospective
  needs_work -> transition to ACTIVE to continue working
